(CURRENTLY AMENDED) A system for treating obesity, the system comprising: a gastric space filler comprising a first balloon connected to a second balloon by a conduit, wherein the gastric space filler is configured to occupy a substantial volume of a gastric cavity in the human patient in an inflated state; and an instrument throughput channel extending through the conduit, wherein the instrument throughput channel is configured to receive instruments that are passed therethrough.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 32 wherein the conduit comprises a first lumen in fluid communication with the first balloon, a second lumen in fluid communication with the second balloon, and a third lumen defining the instrument throughput channel that is configured to facilitate instrument passage.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 33 wherein the conduit has an axial length, and wherein the instrument throughput channel extends along the axial length of the conduit.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 34 wherein the gastric space filler further comprises a coupling mechanism located at a proximal end of the conduit, configured to facilitate engagement with a retrieval device for removal of the gastric space filler from the gastric cavity.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 35 wherein the first and second balloons are made from at least one of the following: silicone, latex, polyethylene, polyurethane, and nylon material.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 36 wherein the conduit comprises an inter-balloon section spacing the first balloon apart from the second balloon, and wherein the inter-balloon section has a length of about 10-40 mm and connects the first and second balloons. 

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The system of claim 41, further comprising a delivery catheter configured to deliver the gastric space filler to the gastric cavity via an esophagus of the patient, wherein the delivery catheter is configured to receive the gastric space filler in a collapsed state prior to delivery. 

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The gastric space filler system of claim 42 wherein: a first lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the first balloon, wherein the first lumen is used for fluid passage; and the second lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to the second balloon, wherein the second lumen is used for fluid passage.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The gastric space filler system of claim 44 wherein the third lumen extends from the first end of the conduit to a second end of the conduit, thereby enabling instrument access.

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The gastric space filler system of claim 46 wherein the gastric space filler system is configured for delivery through an esophagus of a patient to a stomach of the patient with an easy access method. 

(CURRENTLY AMENDED) The gastric space filler system of claim 47 wherein the conduit is configured for attachment to a delivery catheter, and wherein the third lumen of the conduit is configured to receive an instrument passed through the delivery catheter for enhanced functionality.
